BETA Close X RS Group PLC has purchased 194,000 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme, with the purchases occurring between August 17th and August 21st, 2026, at a volume-weighted average price of approximately 725.6 pence per share. Following these transactions, the total number of issued ordinary shares is now 469,722,638, with no shares held in treasury, resulting in a total of 469,722,638 voting rights. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 24 August 2026 RS Group plc 24 August 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 17 August 2026 to 21 August 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange.
